name: Kai Monteago
source:
Being the center of attention has always been natural for Kai. As the Ultimate Influencer, most of the day is spent posting on social media and talking to followers. But Kai doesn't just love the spotlight, he also loves creating drama and conflict. Knowing that his army of fans will follow him to the end of time and that he is not afraid to utilize them, Kai might be the most charismatic yet terrifying person you'll ever cross paths with.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/ProjEdensGarden/status/1355701387322159105]official description[/url]]
